subject: Trade update October: PPWR and your cup range, lid prices 2027
body:
View this email in your browser: https://corvapack.eu/trade/news/2026-10

CORVA PACK | TRADE UPDATE | OCTOBER 2026

Hello Harbor Lane Provisions,

1. PPWR: what changes for takeaway cups
The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation applies from August 2026, and the first recyclability rules for cups and lids follow in 2030. All Corva double wall cups are already made from single-polymer board. Our sales team can send you the declarations of conformity per SKU.

2. New: plastic-free sip lids
From November our 80 mm and 90 mm sip lids are also available in moulded fibre. Same fit, slightly higher price. Samples on request.

3. Price notice for 2027
Board and PET prices are up again this year. List prices for cups and lids will rise by 3 to 5% from 1 January 2027. Orders placed before 15 December are invoiced at current prices.

4. Christmas and New Year
Our warehouse is closed from 24 December to 1 January. Last deliveries before Christmas leave on 22 December.

Questions? Reply to this email or call your account manager.
